_comment: Shape copied from flying_kick_yellow (PLAY + conditions + MODIFY_ATTACK on its own attack). HEALTH_LT_OPP is controller-perspective (controller.life < opponent.life, condition_types.py), which matches 'if you have less {h} than an opposing hero'. Note: the engine compares against the single opposing player (players[3 - pid]); 'an opposing hero' is multiplayer wording, so this is exact only in 1v1.
